def normalize_text(text):
    text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text

def extract_quotes(text):
    quotes = []
    # Blockquotes with quotes: > "..." or > *"..."*
    for m in re.finditer(r'>\s*["\'](.*?)["\']', text):
        q = m.group(1).strip()
        if len(q) > 15:
            quotes.append({"quote": q, "type": "blockquote"})
    # Blockquotes with italics: > *“...”* or > *"..."*
    for m in re.finditer(r'>\s*[\*\_]+["“](.*?)["”][\*\_]+', text):
        q = m.group(1).strip()
        if len(q) > 15 and not any(x["quote"] == q for x in quotes):
            quotes.append({"quote": q, "type": "blockquote_italic"})
    # Inline bold or italic quotes: *"..."* or **"..."**
    for m in re.finditer(r'[\*\_]+["“](.*?)["”][\*\_]+', text):
        q = m.group(1).strip()
        if len(q) > 25 and not any(x["quote"] == q for x in quotes):
            quotes.append({"quote": q, "type": "inline_quote"})
    # Standalone blockquote lines without quotation marks: > text
    for m in re.finditer(r'>\s+([A-Z][^"\n\r]{20,})', text):
        q = m.group(1).strip()
        if len(q) > 25 and not any(x["quote"] == q for x in quotes):
            quotes.append({"quote": q, "type": "raw_blockquote"})
    return quotes

def match_quote_against_transcripts(quote, transcripts_dict):
    norm_q = normalize_text(quote)
    if not norm_q:
        return None, 0.0, "EMPTY"
    
    # 1. Exact match in any transcript
    for name, text in transcripts_dict.items():
        norm_t = normalize_text(text)
        if norm_q in norm_t:
            return name, 1.0, "EXACT"
            
    # 2. Substring anchor match (first 5 words)
    q_words = norm_q.split()
    if len(q_words) >= 4:
        anchor = " ".join(q_words[:min(5, len(q_words))])
        best_name = None
        best_ratio = 0.0
        for name, text in transcripts_dict.items():
            norm_t = normalize_text(text)
            if anchor in norm_t:
                idx = norm_t.find(anchor)
                snippet = norm_t[idx:idx + len(norm_q) + 150]
                ratio = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, norm_q, snippet[:len(norm_q)]).ratio()
                if ratio > best_ratio:
                    best_ratio = ratio
                    best_name = name
        if best_ratio >= 0.80:
            return best_name, best_ratio, "FUZZY_ANCHOR"

    # 3. Global sliding window fuzzy scan
    best_name = None
    best_ratio = 0.0
    q_len = len(q_words)
    if q_len > 0:
        for name, text in transcripts_dict.items():
            t_words = normalize_text(text).split()
            step = max(1, q_len // 3)
            for i in range(0, len(t_words) - q_len + 1, step):

                ratio = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, norm_q, win).ratio()
                if ratio > best_ratio:

                    best_name = name
                    if best_ratio >= 0.95:

    text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text

def extract_quotes(text):
    quotes = []
    # Blockquotes with quotes: > "..." or > *"..."*
    for m in re.finditer(r'>\s*["\'](.*?)["\']', text):
        q = m.group(1).strip()
        if len(q) > 15:
            quotes.append({"quote": q, "type": "blockquote"})
    # Blockquotes with italics: > *“...”* or > *"..."*
    for m in re.finditer(r'>\s*[\*\_]+["“](.*?)["”][\*\_]+', text):
        q = m.group(1).strip()
        if len(q) > 15 and not any(x["quote"] == q for x in quotes):
            quotes.append({"quote": q, "type": "blockquote_italic"})
    # Inline bold or italic quotes: *"..."* or **"..."**
    for m in re.finditer(r'[\*\_]+["“](.*?)["”][\*\_]+', text):
        q = m.group(1).strip()
        if len(q) > 20 and not any(x["quote"] == q for x in quotes):
            quotes.append({"quote": q, "type": "inline_quote"})
    return quotes

def match_quote(quote, transcripts_dict):
    norm_q = normalize_text(quote)
    if not norm_q:
        return None, 0.0, "EMPTY"
    
    # 1. Exact match
    for name, text in transcripts_dict.items():
        norm_t = normalize_text(text)
        if norm_q in norm_t:
            return name, 1.0, "EXACT"
            
    # 2. Substring anchor match (first 4 words)
    q_words = norm_q.split()
    if len(q_words) >= 4:
        anchor = " ".join(q_words[:min(5, len(q_words))])
        best_name = None
        best_ratio = 0.0
        for name, text in transcripts_dict.items():
            norm_t = normalize_text(text)
            if anchor in norm_t:

                snippet = norm_t[idx:idx + len(norm_q) + 150]
                ratio = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, norm_q, snippet[:len(norm_q)]).ratio()
                if ratio > best_ratio:
                    best_ratio = ratio
                    best_name = name
        if best_ratio >= 0.80:
            return best_name, best_ratio, "FUZZY_ANCHOR"

    # 3. Global sliding window fuzzy scan
    best_name = None
    best_ratio = 0.0
    q_len = len(q_words)
    if q_len > 0:
        for name, text in transcripts_dict.items():
            t_words = normalize_text(text).split()
            step = max(1, q_len // 3)

                if ratio > best_ratio:

                    best_name = name
                    if best_ratio >= 0.95:

    return best_name, best_ratio, "NOT_FOUND"
